messages.subject: Kinship matrix using BXD data
parts:
I have a question on how best to use the kinship matrix given the following study design that employs BXD strains. We have two age time points  and two status (NonTg and Tg). We would like to model age and genotype as additive and interactive covariates (as and when appropriate). Since we are working with BXD strains we will, in essence, be replicating the strain genotypes so as to model these covariates. Is It valid to create a kinship matrix in this manner as well, where strains occur two or more times? Does this introduce a blocking structure that influences the mapping results?  Or, is it better to spit the data and model/map each slice separately with a kinship matrix where a strain occurs only once? 

 

Thank you in advance for your help on this.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Kinship matrix using BXD data
parts:
In theory it should work, but I don't have any experience applying this in practice.
You might also look at the averages and differences of a trait in the different conditions.

karl
